pages.label: Wikipedia: Bouldering
pages.intent: What is bouldering and how does it differ from other rock climbing?

improved.description: Bouldering is rock climbing on short walls or boulders without ropes or harnesses, using climbing shoes, chalk and crash pads, with problems graded on scales such as the V-scale.

pages.label: BBC Good Food: Easy pancakes
pages.intent: How do I make easy pancakes at home?

improved.description: Make easy pancakes at home: whisk 100g plain flour, 2 eggs and 300ml milk into a batter, rest it, then cook thin pancakes in a hot frying pan and add your toppings.

pages.label: GitHub Docs: Hello World
pages.intent: How do I create my first repository, branch and pull request on GitHub?

improved.description: Create your first GitHub repository, start a branch, commit a change to the README file, then open and merge a pull request in this Hello World tutorial.

pages.label: South Australia: Kangaroo Island
pages.intent: What can I see and do on a trip to Kangaroo Island?

improved.description: Plan a Kangaroo Island trip: see sea lions, koalas and Remarkable Rocks, explore national parks and beaches, taste local produce, and take the ferry from the mainland.

pages.label: MDN: HTTP 404
pages.intent: What does the HTTP 404 Not Found status code mean?

improved.description: HTTP 404 Not Found is a client error status code: the server cannot find the requested resource. Use 410 Gone for permanent removal and redirects for moved pages.

pages.label: Lifeblood: Eligibility
pages.intent: Am I eligible to donate blood in Australia?

improved.description: Check if you can donate blood in Australia: take the Lifeblood eligibility quiz and see how medication, tattoos, travel and other factors affect donating blood, plasma or platelets.

pages.label: CommBank: Home loans
pages.intent: Which CommBank home loan suits me and how do I apply?

improved.description: Compare CommBank home loans: variable and fixed rates, offset accounts and options for first home buyers, refinancers and investors. Use our calculators and apply online.

pages.label: NASA: Humans in space
pages.intent: What is NASA doing to send humans into space?

improved.description: How NASA sends humans into space: astronauts on the International Space Station, the Artemis missions to the Moon, preparations for Mars, and commercial crew partners.

pages.label: GOV.UK: Apply for a passport
pages.intent: How do I apply online for a UK passport?

improved.description: Apply online for a UK passport: renew, replace or update your passport and pay by debit or credit card. Check processing times, or use Fast Track if it's urgent.

pages.label: IKEA: Bedroom
pages.intent: What bedroom furniture and design ideas does IKEA offer?

improved.description: Explore IKEA bedroom furniture and ideas: beds, mattresses, wardrobes, chests of drawers, bedding and bedside tables, plus small-bedroom storage and free design help.
